rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: Message 40, 'ALHUMAID CHAIRS SHOURA COUNCIL', Riyadh Feb. 12: 'DR. SALEH BIN ABDULLAH BIN HUMAID, CHAIRMAN OF THE SHOURA COUNCIL, WHO REPLACED LATE SHEIKH MOHAMMED BIN IBRAHIM BIN JUBAIR, TODAY SAID AT THE COUNCIL'S FIRST SESSION UNDER HIS CHAIRMANSHIP' that he felt the pressure of responsibility; message 41 says the regular 56th meeting followed his speech.

rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: Message 42 of the same page, on pilgrim numbers, prints '28/11/1422 H. CORRESPONDING TO FEBRUARY 11, 2002'.

bounded_scope: Chair observations for CLAUDE-C01-25 only (sa_shura_chair and sa_succession_chair).
